context: Generates realistic river networks that carve through the terrain and remain consistent across levels of detail.
description: Calculates flow accumulation from rainfall and topography to determine river paths and modifies the heightfield to carve riverbeds.

classes.name: RiverSystem
classes.description: Helper used by UWorldGenerator to create rivers.

methods.name: ComputeFlowDirection(heightField)
methods.description: Compute for each cell the index of its steepest downhill neighbor.
methods.pseudocode: For each cell: inspect neighbors; pick the neighbor with the lowest elevation; store direction.

methods.name: FlowAccumulation(directionMap)
methods.description: Accumulate flow by counting the number of upstream cells draining through each cell.
methods.pseudocode: Initialize accumulation to 1; traverse cells in topological order; add accumulation of upstream neighbors.

methods.name: ExtractRivers(accumulationMap, threshold)
methods.description: Identify cells that form river channels based on accumulated flow.
methods.pseudocode: Mark cells where accumulation > threshold as river; connect them into polylines; merge into a graph.

methods.name: CarveRiver(heightField, riverGraph)
methods.description: Lower the terrain along river paths to form channels with width and depth proportional to flow.
methods.pseudocode: For each river spline: for each point along the spline: lower heightField by depth f(flow) within width f(flow).

pseudocode: Compute flow directions and accumulation, threshold to define rivers, then carve the terrain.
